screen_pump_004f8830.guard: The 00425d10 singleton's byte +25Ch (modal dialog) narrows the body to that one screen's virtual +20h and returns unless game+1FE4h and 00E198C4 are both set.
passes: 004f8890 exit: wanted == 0 and active != 0 -> virtual +1Ch; then if still active, clear active and run 004f83b0
004f88d0 enter: wanted != 0 and active == 0 -> set active, run 004f83b0, then virtual +18h (the commit runs before the virtual here, the opposite of the exit pass)
004f8906 update: both set -> virtual +20h with the raw delta

shared_tail_vs_blocking_screen: The blocking path reaches the renderer through BSP_Game_TryBeginRenderFrame (004c6c30) at 004e4b4e; the front-end path open-codes the same test against 00F8D394 and sets game+34h itself.
On a retained queue the blocking path skips only the render; the front-end path skips the per-state update too and lands on the pending-request check.
The front-end path runs 004f8830 before the GUI update; the blocking path never touches the screen registry.
The blocking path returns unconditionally at 004e4b8c; the front-end path returns only when the request ring is empty or the drain kept a front-end state.

transitions.1_to_2: 00685170 requires BOTH elapsed > this+78h (BSP_Timestamp_Subtract on this+68h, reduced by fild[eax]/fild[eax+8]) AND the edge-triggered 004d92b0(game, 0x4A) before tail-jumping to 00685070. 00685070 advances this+60h through the 8-byte-element vector at this+44h..+48h; when exhausted it runs the object's virtual +0h with 1 and then BSP_Game_OnInitOnce(game, 0), which re-runs GGame::OnInitTitle and writes game+5D4h = 2 directly, not through the ring.
transitions.1_to_2_uncertainty: Because the two conditions are ANDed, 00685170 cannot advance on time alone. The automatic advance is not in this body and its location is unresolved.
transitions.2_to_4: BSP_Game_RequestState (004d7920) has 28 call sites; exactly two push 4, at 0068d8bc in BSP_TitleScreen_Skip and 0068d90e in BSP_TitleScreen_Advance (title vtable 00CF7A98 slot +4h). Both are guarded by game+5E8h == 0 and both then clear game+5ECh. GGame::OnInitTitle calls the virtual normally and BSP_TitleScreen_Skip when skipTitle is set.
transitions.mission_to_4: OnMove's state 0x11 branch enqueues 4 at 004e5074, guarded by game+7184h == 0 and an empty ring, so state 17 hands off to the front-end shell, which picks the _RETURN loading label because game+719Ch is already set. The drain holds a second copy of the same block at 004e478b, but it is NOT reached from the state-17 store at 004e4778, which sets game+5ECh = 1 and jumps past it to 004e47bd; the predecessor of 004e478b was not identified.
transitions.out_of_4: 004db311 in BSP_Game_PollPlatformSessionEvents is the only compare against 4 outside OnMove: state 4 takes BSP_Game_RequestReturnToTitle, every other state takes the inline GGame::OnInitTitle path.

address_0054e440.call_site: 004e522d, inside the in-mission pause branch of the simulation gate, with ECX = *(00E198C4 + 0xA8), guarded by that object's byte +8h.
address_0054e440.behavior: Clears its own +8h/+9h, calls this+20h virtual +34h with 0, 004d94f0(game, 0), zeroes the float at +54h, stops the input feedback effects at slots +2FD0h and +0DE0h, then reads the hint id from the award tracker (004e1ca0 then 0068e5b0) and advances it one step: BASICPLANE -> BASICPLANE2 via strcmp 00BF7FBF, then via the native-string comparison 00425850 BASICPLANE2 -> BASICPLANE3, BASICSHIP -> BASICSHIP2, BASICSUB -> BASICSUB2. Hands the result to 00690fd0, whose body holds hints.missionhint and the HintSystem Lua strings.
address_0054e440.supersedes: docs/GAME_ON_MOVE_MAP.md files it as 'front-end button segment' and 'BSP_PauseMenu_BuildUnitList'.
